create.name: Nancy Zabaneh
create.bio:
Nancy Zabaneh is a Kundalini Yoga teacher and teacher trainer who has lived in Dubai for around two decades. Canadian, of Arab heritage, she spent close to ten years in banking, strategy and public affairs for large Gulf institutions before a personal turning point led her into transpersonal psychology and Kundalini Yoga. She trains teachers with the Aquarian Teacher Academy, and in 2017 she set up Darshan, a platform for Kundalini teacher trainings and community learning that has helped bring the practice to students across the Arab world.

Her classes move between strong, rhythmic sets with breath, mantra and shaking and quieter periods of stillness and sound, each built around a theme. She leads retreats in places of spiritual and natural significance, among them Ephesus, Amritsar, the Wadi Rum desert and Zanzibar, combining Kundalini practice with contemplative and somatic work, and she leads group meditation and yoga sessions at regional wellness festivals. Her YouTube channel holds short sung meditations on mantras such as Ra Ma Da Sa and Ang Sang Wahe Guru alongside longer guided practices on compassion, forgiveness and acceptance. She also works as a counsellor, which is not part of this listing.

courses.title: Kundalini Yoga classes
courses.description: Themed Kundalini Yoga sessions weaving breath, mantra, movement and meditation, some lively and cathartic, others slow and inward. Offered as group classes and within her trainings and festival appearances; book through her contact form.

courses.title: Retreats
courses.description: Residential retreats in places such as Ephesus, Amritsar, Wadi Rum and Zanzibar, combining Kundalini Yoga with contemplative and somatic practice and time in community. Enquiries go through her contact form.

flags: Health restore (old skip asked for an owner's second look): she is listed for Kundalini Yoga, retreats and meditation videos only. Counselling, Compassionate Inquiry (a psychotherapeutic approach she coordinates in the Arab world) and the Beyond Addiction programme are left out.

Her retreats page names Beyond Addiction and Compassionate Inquiry among the practices woven into retreats; the retreat item is kept, described by its yoga and contemplative content, but the owner may prefer to drop it.
Her Kundalini page says the practice strengthens the nervous system and balances the glands (traditional Kundalini wording, no disease named); kept as wellbeing wording under the 12 Nov rule.
No published email: contact form only (/get-in-touch/). A WhatsApp number is also linked.
Teacher trainings through Darshan are mentioned on her About page, but no Darshan site or training page was found on her site; not listed.
Items: 2 offerings, both 'Contact for pricing', plus 10 videos (all pass oEmbed). Her channel's most-viewed videos are TV interviews, which are left out.
Two photos from her own site, same person (1827 and 1850 px wide, looked at). Her YouTube avatar is a default image.
Regional: Dubai, where Spiritpedia has few teachers.
left_out: Counselling (/counseling/) and Compassionate Inquiry work: psychotherapy.
Corporate activations (/corporate-activations/): workplace programmes, not opened.
Special events (/special-events/): festival appearances with no bookable item of their own.

Videos: Sama Dubai TV Interview, Dubai TV Interview, Expo 2020 clip, Abu Dhabi TV stress segment (media appearances); Yoga Fest ME Highlights (under 1 minute); talks on trauma and dissociation ('Trauma: An Unconscious Window', 'Lost and Found Navigating the Path of Dissociation'): psychological framing; 'Yoga, Social Impact, and Engagement' and 'On the Mat, In the World': talks rather than practice.
